_notes: Base defensive front by franchise and season. Used to decide whether a linebacker-labeled
draftee was a 3-4 outside linebacker (edge rusher -> Madden LEDG/REDG) or an off-ball
linebacker (SAM/MIKE/WILL). Only 3-4 eras are listed; any (franchise, season) not covered
is treated as a 4-3. Nothing before 1972 is a 3-4 (the Dolphins' 53 defense was the first).
Franchise ids are Pro-Football-Reference codes (clt = Colts, oti = Oilers/Titans, htx = Texans,
rai = Raiders, ram = Rams, sdg = Chargers, crd = Cardinals, rav = Ravens).
'to': null means through the present. 'confidence' is editorial: high = well documented,
medium = coordinator/era inference. Edit freely; the classifier re-reads this file on restart.
